messages:
alex: quick sync — captured a few audit logging coverage gaps after yesterday's onboarding call. want to triage owners/runbook items for api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. can folks grab ownership?

maria: I can take api-gateway and console. noted gaps: no authz decision events on 4xx responses, and the console doesn't emit customer_id on admin actions.

jamal: I'll own auth + runtime. for runtime we still don't log model_version or quantization_profile on serve events — makes it impossible to correlate regressions.

irene: billing gaps look bad — we only log invoice generation, not rate-limited or quota-denied events. customers can request audits and we wouldn't be able to prove denial reasons. happy to own billing.

alex: thanks. high-level triage items per service: api-gateway -> add authz_decision, route, peer_ip, and request_id; auth -> emit rbac_role_changes + actor_kms_key when KMS used; console -> include customer_id, session_id; billing -> quota_reason + plan_snapshot; runtime -> model_version, quant_profile, seq_len.

jamal: on KMS: we need a schema field for kms_key_id and kms_key_version for SSE usage and for customer-managed keys. proposal: add "kms": {"key_id": "", "key_version": ""} into events. any objections?

maria: prefer flat fields so downstream parsers don't break. e.g., kms_key_id and kms_key_version as top-level strings. keep events schema v2 compatible.

irene: +1 flat fields. also we should document which events must include the kms fields (key-rotate, key-use during encrypt, key-delete).

alex: agreed — flat fields. also need an enum for event_outcome: success|failure|denied to help customer-facing audits.

jamal: quick note on privacy: if kms_key_id is customer-managed and sensitive, we should redact full ARN in customer-facing exports and only include short id. put that in runbook.

audit-bot: automated: missing audit_event -> service=api-gateway, event=authz_decision, count=128 (last 24h). :eyes:

maria: ran a small grep across prod logs — gap is real. I'll open a PR to add the event on the gateway filter chain and include tests. estimated work: 1 day for impl, 1 day for e2e test.

jamal: for runtime, we need to modify the inference-trace emitter. I'm worried about token overhead — including model_version + quant_profile adds ~120 bytes per request. we should gate by plan tier or sampling.

alex: we can sample by default (1%) and allow customers to opt-in full trace for dedicated/private. add sampling field trace_sample_rate.

irene: for customer-facing validation: propose a checklist + test harness that can be run during onboarding. items: 1) run known RBAC change and verify audit event contains actor, actor_role_before/after, resource, outcome. 2) rotate KMS key and check kms_key_id present. 3) simulate quota denial and confirm billing event includes quota_reason and plan_snapshot.

maria: I'll draft the runbook template and validation scripts. Deliverable: runbook markdown + pytest-based harness that hits staging endpoints and asserts schema presence.

jamal: note: runtime change needs a config flag and migration to avoid blowing up log indexing. we should add index_hint tags to events so ELK/Clickhouse schemas can map fields without reindexing.

alex: action items: maria -> PR for gateway + console, include schema diff and test plan. jamal -> runtime emitter PR + sampling + index_hint. irene -> billing PR + onboarding validation harness. alex -> consolidate schema v2 RFC and post link here. owners, please add ETA comments in the PR.

maria: putting ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow, tests next week.

jamal: ETA: prototype by Thu, sampling flag doc in PR.

irene: ETA: billing PR Wed, harness Wed-Thu.

alex: thanks. I'll author RFC today: minimal changes only (flat kms fields, event_outcome enum, trace_sample_rate, index_hint). will post RFC link when ready.

maria: tiny question — should RBAC role change events include previous_role and new_role or a role_diff blob?

jamal: previous_role + new_role is easiest to query. keep role_diff for optional human-readable.

irene: recording: escalate if customer requests full audit and we only sampled — run on-demand full export or enable dedicated trace for that customer. add to runbook.

alex: noted. final: owners, tag me in PR reviews and set milestone `audit-coverage-q2`. closing this thread after RFC posted. :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: note: RFC link placeholder created by alex -> /rfc/audit-schema-v2 (will update).
